context.pubinfo_note: From the Consilience cross-theory demo (consilience-demo.netlify.app); its results are pinned in https://github.com/Anuja-Khatri/theconsilience-engine at commit 96ba4e435bd13718d36435cc3436d938d2d1f894, results/demo/. The demo's check rules this disagreement decidable with instruments that exist today and names the shared observable both claims bear on. This is a statement about the two claim cards, not a verdict on either theory. The axis is an axis of theoretical commitment, not a quantity axis, so no margin or floor applies. The claim statements in the linked claim cards are reviewed paraphrases with page locators, not quotations. The demo marks this pair as a type divergence: the two claims are different kinds of claim (process and substrate).

left.statement: Conscious information is not transmitted or broadcast from one brain region to another; the locus of consciousness is intrinsic to the PSC, not a relay or global broadcast.
left.direction: “Conscious information is not transmitted or broadcast from one brain region to another; the locus of consciousness is intrinsic to the PSC, not a relay or global broadcast.” (n013) — expected on shared observables: regional_decoding

right.statement: The locus of conscious processing is a large-scale prefrontal-parietal (and cingulate/temporal) cortical network, not posterior sensory cortices alone.
right.direction: “The locus of conscious processing is a large-scale prefrontal-parietal (and cingulate/temporal) cortical network, not posterior sensory cortices alone.” (c003) — expected on shared observables: regional_decoding
